text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
First-rate isn't built in a day!
Now then, let's do our usual routine today!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ah— Ah— Throat feels totally fine.
Alright—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hmm... The high notes lack sufficient resonance. They fail to convey the majestic presence expected of the first-rate.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Not yet, King!
A first-rate haughty laugh has gotta be way better than this!!

—That day, King Halo showed up
at the training grounds looking rather exhausted...
